name: VA-08
label: Safe D

key_factors: Don Beyer is a well-funded incumbent in a D+26 district
Republican Tony Sabio has raised only about $22,000
Prediction markets price Democratic win odds near 96%
No general-election polling, but fundamentals are lopsided
model.rationale: Beyer holds a heavily Democratic Northern Virginia seat, has raised over $2.1 million against a challenger with about $22,000, and markets price his reelection near certain. Fundamentals point to a margin near 28 points, so no evidence justifies moving from that baseline.
model.watch: A surprise polling miss or major outside spending against Beyer could narrow the margin, though nothing currently signals that.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Don Beyer seeks another term in this Northern Virginia district, which leans Democratic by 26 points. He enters with a large financial advantage, having raised about $2.1 million and holding over $800,000 on hand, while Republican Tony Sabio has raised roughly $22,000. Independent and Libertarian candidates are on the ballot but lack resources.

No public general-election polls are available, and no expert raters cover the race, so the outlook rests on fundamentals. Prediction markets give Beyer roughly a 96 percent chance of winning. With the incumbent, the district lean, and the money gap all aligned, this seat is rated Safe Democratic.
